Top-down distant geographic perspective, subtle realistic land relief, crisp enough coast outlines to read as geography, muted deep slate blue sea, desaturated charcoal olive land, soft subdued illumination, restrained detail for use behind long text under a dark overlay. No text, place names, numbers, border lines, icons, arrows, routes, markers, data overlays, grid, watermarks, logos, image credits or attribution. No screenshots or imagery from mapping providers. No city-scale operational details, no photo of a paper map. Calm, elegant, natural terrain texture. Composition: wide North Atlantic overview inspired by Greenland, Iceland, northern Europe and eastern North America, ocean in the centre, coastlines and broad mountainous land masses around it. Broad near-vertical overhead view rather than a globe with a horizon. Keep the central Atlantic sea relatively quiet for text.
